chapters.title: Can the same message cost fewer bits?
Repeatedly merge the two lightest items
A midpoint cell fits inside each probability interval
Encoder and decoder add identical phrases

captions.text: Two bits for every source symbol sounds simple. Can a prefix code do better?
captions.translation: 每个信源符号都用两比特很简单。前缀码还能更省吗？

captions.text: Imagine one hundred source symbols: fifty A, thirty B, and twenty C. Their order does not change this bit bill.
captions.translation: 设有一百个信源符号：五十个A、三十个B、二十个C。排列顺序不改变这笔比特账单。

captions.text: The first codebook uses A zero zero, B zero one, and C one zero. It costs two hundred bits.
captions.translation: 第一本码表取A为00、B为01、C为10，共用二百比特。

captions.text: You may give one symbol a shorter word. Which symbol should receive it?
captions.translation: 现在可以给一个符号更短的码字。应该选谁？

captions.text: A occurs most often. Try A zero, B one zero, and C one one zero.
captions.translation: A出现最多。试取A为0、B为10、C为110。

captions.text: The bill falls to one hundred seventy bits. Both codebooks are prefix-free.
captions.translation: 账单降到一百七十比特。这两本码表都是前缀码。

captions.text: But A zero, B one zero, and C one one uses only one hundred fifty bits for the same inventory.
captions.translation: 而A为0、B为10、C为11时，同样的一百个符号只用一百五十比特。

captions.text: Why three different bills? The probability model and the tree construction both matter.
captions.translation: 为什么会有三笔不同的账单？概率模型和码树构造都会影响代价。

captions.text: Let P be the true source distribution and Q the coding model.
captions.translation: 令P为真实信源分布，Q为编码所用模型。

captions.text: The source produces symbols according to P.
captions.translation: 信源按照P产生符号。

captions.text: The encoder assigns Shannon lengths using Q.
captions.translation: 编码器使用Q分配Shannon码长。

captions.text: For each symbol i, set l i to ceiling of negative log two Q i.
captions.translation: 对每个符号i，令lᵢ=⌈−log₂Qᵢ⌉。

captions.text: Assume Q is positive wherever P is positive.
captions.translation: 假设凡P为正之处，Q也为正。

captions.text: Also assume at least two Q probabilities are positive.
captions.translation: 并假设至少两个Q概率为正。

captions.text: Then the Shannon construction gives a prefix code.
captions.translation: 此时Shannon构造可得到前缀码。

captions.text: First imagine using ideal real-valued lengths negative log Q i.
captions.translation: 先设想使用理想实数码长−log₂Qᵢ。

captions.text: Average those lengths under the true distribution P.
captions.translation: 按照真实分布P对这些码长取平均。

captions.text: The result is the cross entropy from P to Q.
captions.translation: 所得结果是P到Q的交叉熵。

captions.text: Expand it as the sum of negative P i log Q i.
captions.translation: 将它展开为−ΣᵢPᵢlog₂Qᵢ。

captions.text: Add and subtract negative P i log P i.
captions.translation: 加上并减去−Pᵢlog₂Pᵢ。

captions.text: The first group is entropy H of P.
captions.translation: 第一组就是熵H(P)。

captions.text: The remaining group is divergence D of P from Q.
captions.translation: 剩余部分是D(P∥Q)。

captions.text: So ideal expected length equals H of P plus D of P relative to Q.
captions.translation: 因此理想期望码长等于H(P)+D(P∥Q)。

captions.text: Integer ceiling never shortens an ideal length.
captions.translation: 取整数上整不会缩短理想码长。

captions.text: It adds strictly less than one bit to each positive-probability symbol.
captions.translation: 它给每个正概率符号增加严格少于一比特。

captions.text: Averaging gives H of P plus divergence, at most L Q.
captions.translation: 取平均得H(P)+D(P∥Q)≤L_Q。

captions.text: The strict ceiling bound also gives L Q less than H plus divergence plus one.
captions.translation: 严格取整界还给出L_Q<H(P)+D(P∥Q)+1。

captions.text: Thus the full mismatch bound is H plus KL at most L Q, below H plus KL plus one.
captions.translation: 所以错配界为H+KL≤L_Q<H+KL+1。

captions.text: When Q equals P, the divergence vanishes.
captions.translation: 当Q=P时，KL散度为零。

captions.text: At the ideal real-length level, mismatch adds the nonnegative KL penalty.
captions.translation: 在理想实数码长层面，错配增加非负KL代价。

captions.text: The penalty is asymmetric because KL divergence is asymmetric.
captions.translation: KL散度不对称，因此该惩罚也有方向性。

captions.text: If Q i is zero while P i is positive, that source symbol has infinite ideal length.
captions.translation: 若Qᵢ为零而Pᵢ为正，该信源符号的理想码长为无穷。

captions.text: No finite Shannon codeword can be assigned by that zero-probability model.
captions.translation: 该零概率模型无法用Shannon公式为此符号分配有限码字。

captions.text: A usable model must cover the true source support.
captions.translation: 可用模型必须覆盖真实信源的支持集。

captions.text: Probabilities where P is zero contribute nothing to the P-weighted expectation.
captions.translation: P为零处的概率不贡献P加权期望。

captions.text: This avoids taking a positive weight times an undefined logarithm.
captions.translation: 这样可避免正权重乘以未定义对数。

captions.text: The entropy term describes the matched baseline.
captions.translation: 熵项描述匹配模型时的基线。

captions.text: The divergence term isolates the cost of using Q instead.
captions.translation: 散度项单独刻画改用Q造成的代价。

captions.text: This identity lets us compare models without drawing code trees.
captions.translation: 利用该恒等式，无需画码树也能比较模型。

captions.text: Next, we seek an optimal prefix tree when the true probabilities are known.
captions.translation: 接下来，在真实概率已知时寻找最优前缀树。

captions.text: Huffman coding builds a binary prefix tree from known symbol probabilities.
captions.translation: Huffman编码根据已知符号概率构造二叉前缀树。

captions.text: At each step, choose two smallest current weights.
captions.translation: 每一步选取当前最小的两个权重。

captions.text: Join them as siblings under a new parent.
captions.translation: 将它们合并为新父节点下的兄弟节点。

captions.text: Give the parent the sum of their weights.
captions.translation: 新父节点的权重等于两者之和。

captions.text: Repeat until one root remains.
captions.translation: 重复操作直到只剩一个根节点。

captions.text: Assign zero and one to the two branches at each split.
captions.translation: 在每次分叉处为两条边分别标记0和1。

captions.text: Read each symbol codeword along its root-to-leaf path.
captions.translation: 沿根到叶的路径读取每个符号的码字。

captions.text: The resulting leaves define a prefix code.
captions.translation: 所得叶节点构成前缀码。

captions.text: Use probabilities .4, .2, .2, .1, .05, and .05.
Label these symbols A, B, C, D, E, and F in that order.
captions.translation: 依次将这些符号标为A、B、C、D、E、F。

captions.text: Break ties by placing leaves before compound nodes, then alphabetical order. Which pair goes first?
captions.translation: 平局时，叶节点优先于合并节点，再按字母排序。第一步应合并哪一对？

captions.text: First merge E and F, each with weight .05.
captions.translation: 先合并权重均为.05的E和F。

captions.text: Their parent EF has weight .10.
captions.translation: 父节点EF的权重为.10。

captions.text: Next merge D at .10 with EF at .10.
captions.translation: 接着将D的.10与EF的.10合并。

captions.text: The new node DEF has weight .20. Three items now weigh .20. Which pair does our tie rule choose?
captions.translation: 新节点DEF的权重为0.20。现在有三个0.20项。平局规则会选哪一对？

captions.text: Among the three .20 items, choose leaves B and C first.
captions.translation: 三个.20项并列时，先选叶节点B和C。

captions.text: Their parent BC has weight .40.
captions.translation: 父节点BC的权重为.40。

captions.text: Now merge DEF at .20 with A at .40.
captions.translation: 现在合并.20的DEF与.40的A。

captions.text: The resulting node has weight .60.
captions.translation: 所得节点权重为.60。

captions.text: Finally merge BC at .40 with that .60 node.
captions.translation: 最后将.40的BC与该.60节点合并。

captions.text: For a reproducible tree, put the first item on the zero branch.
captions.translation: 为固定树形，将每次所选第一项放在0分支。

captions.text: Symbol A receives one one; symbol B receives zero zero; symbol C receives zero one.
captions.translation: 符号A的码字为11，符号B为00，符号C为01。

captions.text: D receives one zero zero.
captions.translation: D获得100。

captions.text: E receives one zero one zero.
F receives one zero one one.
Their lengths are two, two, two, three, four, and four.
Weight the lengths by the source probabilities.
captions.translation: 用信源概率对码长加权。

captions.text: The mean length is .4 times two plus .2 times two twice.
captions.translation: 平均码长为.4乘2，再加两项.2乘2。

captions.text: Add .1 times three and two terms of .05 times four.
captions.translation: 再加.1乘3，以及两项.05乘4。

captions.text: The result is 2.3 bits per symbol.
captions.translation: 结果为每符号2.3比特。

captions.text: The source entropy is approximately 2.221928 bits per symbol.
captions.translation: 信源熵约为每符号2.221928比特。

captions.text: This finite example shows a small coding gap.
captions.translation: 这个有限例子显示了较小的编码差距。

captions.text: The merge procedure needs a proof before we call it optimal.
captions.translation: 在称该合并过程最优之前，还需要证明。

captions.text: Next, prove that the two lightest symbols can occupy deepest sibling leaves.
captions.translation: 接下来证明两个最小概率符号可放在最深兄弟叶上。

captions.text: Consider at least two symbols, all with positive probability, and binary prefix trees.
captions.translation: 考虑至少两个正概率符号及其二元前缀树。

captions.text: A full binary tree with m leaves has exactly m minus one internal nodes.
captions.translation: 有m个叶的满二叉树恰有m−1个内部节点。

captions.text: If an internal node has only one child, contract that edge.
captions.translation: 若某内部节点只有一个子节点，就收缩该边。

captions.text: Every descendant codeword becomes shorter.
captions.translation: 所有后代码字都会变短。

captions.text: Because their probabilities are positive, average length strictly decreases.
captions.translation: 由于它们概率为正，平均码长会严格下降。

captions.text: Therefore an optimal tree has no single-child internal node.
captions.translation: 因此最优树不存在单子节点内部节点。

captions.text: Such a tree is full: every internal node has two children.
captions.translation: 这种树是满二叉树：每个内部节点都有两个子节点。

captions.text: Their depth is at most m minus one, so only finitely many full tree shapes and labels are needed.
captions.translation: 其深度至多为m−1，因此只需考虑有限种满树形状与标签安排。

captions.text: An optimal tree therefore exists among these finitely many candidates.
captions.translation: 因此在这些有限候选中必存在最优树。

captions.text: Choose a leaf at maximum depth.
captions.translation: 选择一个深度最大的叶节点。

captions.text: Its sibling must also be a leaf.
captions.translation: 它的兄弟节点也必为叶节点。

captions.text: Otherwise that sibling subtree would contain a deeper leaf.
captions.translation: 否则兄弟子树中会有更深的叶节点。

captions.text: Name the two lightest symbols A and B. Their probabilities satisfy p sub A at most p sub B.
captions.translation: 将两个最轻符号记为a和b，其概率满足p_a≤p_b。

captions.text: Reserve the two deepest sibling positions. Will moving the lightest labels there increase or decrease the bill?
captions.translation: 留出两个最深的兄弟位置。把最轻的标签移过去，账单会增加还是减少？

captions.text: Move A into one position by exchanging its label with the current occupant u.
captions.translation: 将a与其中一个位置原有标签u交换。

captions.text: If symbol A already belongs to this sibling pair, choose its current position.
captions.translation: 若符号a已经位于这对兄弟叶中，就选它当前的位置。

captions.text: Let its maximum depth be L, at least the original depth of A.
captions.translation: 记该最大深度为L，它不小于a原有深度。

captions.text: The change in cost is p sub A minus p sub u, times L minus the old depth of A.
captions.translation: 代价变化为(pₐ−pᵤ)(L−原来a的深度)。

captions.text: Both factors have opposite signs or are zero, so this change is nonpositive.
captions.translation: 两因子符号相反或为零，因此代价变化非正。

captions.text: Now move B into the other sibling position in the same way.
captions.translation: 再用相同方式将b移到另一个兄弟位置。

captions.text: The other position does not contain symbol A, so its probability is at least p sub B.
captions.translation: 另一位置不含符号a，因此该位置的概率至少为p_b。

captions.text: This second exchange also cannot increase average length.
captions.translation: 第二次交换也不会增加平均码长。

captions.text: Now the deepest sibling pair carries symbol A and symbol B.
captions.translation: 现在，最深的兄弟叶对承载符号a和符号b。

captions.text: Merge them into one pseudo-symbol with probability p sub A plus p sub B.
captions.translation: 将它们合并成概率为pₐ+p_b的伪符号。

captions.text: The pseudo-symbol sits at their parent depth.
captions.translation: 伪符号位于它们父节点的深度。

captions.text: Expanding it back adds one level to both original leaves.
captions.translation: 将其展开后，两个原叶都增加一层深度。

captions.text: That increases total weighted length by exactly p sub A plus p sub B.
captions.translation: 这使加权总码长恰好增加pₐ+p_b。

captions.text: The reduced tree is an optimal tree for the reduced probabilities.
captions.translation: 缩减后的树是缩减概率问题的最优树。

captions.text: If a better reduced tree existed, expanding it would improve the original.
captions.translation: 若存在更优缩减树，将其展开便会改进原问题。

captions.text: That would contradict the original tree’s optimality.
captions.translation: 这将与原树最优性矛盾。

captions.text: Conversely, take an optimal tree for the reduced problem.
captions.translation: 反过来，取缩减问题的一棵最优树。

captions.text: Replace the pseudo-symbol leaf by sibling leaves for symbol A and symbol B.
captions.translation: 将伪符号叶展开为承载符号a和符号b的兄弟叶。

captions.text: The cost rises by the fixed amount p sub A plus p sub B.
captions.translation: 代价增加固定量pₐ+p_b。

captions.text: Thus minimizing the reduced tree also minimizes the expanded tree.
captions.translation: 所以最小化缩减树也就最小化展开树。

captions.text: Induction on the number of symbols proves the repeated merge algorithm optimal.
captions.translation: 对符号数归纳，即可证明重复合并算法最优。

captions.text: With two symbols, codewords zero and one give the full-tree base case.
captions.translation: 两个符号时，码字0和1给出满树归纳基例。

captions.text: The induction step uses the exchange property and exact merge cost.
captions.translation: 归纳步骤依赖交换性质和精确合并代价。

captions.text: For D-ary trees, an internal node has D children.
captions.translation: 对D元树，每个内部节点有D个子节点。

captions.text: A full D-ary tree with m leaves requires m minus one divisible by D minus one.
captions.translation: 满D元树的叶数m须满足m−1可被D−1整除。

captions.text: Pad zero-weight leaves until this congruence holds.
captions.translation: 补入零权重叶，直到满足该同余条件。

captions.text: The needed padding count is the smallest nonnegative r making it hold.
captions.translation: 所需补叶数r是使其成立的最小非负整数。

captions.text: Equivalently, r equals the remainder correction modulo D minus one.
captions.translation: 等价地，r是模D−1所需的余数修正。

captions.text: At each step, merge exactly D of the lightest current weights.
captions.translation: 每一步恰好合并当前最轻的D个权重。

captions.text: The padding leaves do not change positive-symbol weighted cost.
captions.translation: 补入的叶不会改变正概率符号的加权代价。

captions.text: Next, build a prefix code directly from cumulative probability intervals.
captions.translation: 接下来直接从累积概率区间构造前缀码。

captions.text: Order the positive-probability symbols in any fixed sequence.
captions.translation: 按任意固定顺序排列正概率符号。

captions.text: Let F left i be the total probability before symbol i.
captions.translation: 令F_left(i)为符号i之前的累计概率。

captions.text: Symbol i owns the half-open interval from F left i to F left i plus p i.
captions.translation: 符号i拥有半开区间[F_left(i),F_left(i)+p_i)。

captions.text: Its midpoint is F left i plus p i over two.
captions.translation: 其中点为F_left(i)+p_i/2。

captions.text: Let l i equal ceiling of negative log two p i plus one.
captions.translation: 令lᵢ=⌈−log₂pᵢ⌉+1。

captions.text: Write the midpoint in binary and keep its first l i bits.
captions.translation: 将中点写成二进制，并保留前lᵢ位。

captions.text: Those bits identify a dyadic cell of width two to negative l i.
captions.translation: 这些位对应宽度为2^(−lᵢ)的二进制区间。

captions.text: Since l i exceeds negative log two p i by at least one, cell width is at most p i over two.
captions.translation: 由于lᵢ至少比−log₂pᵢ大一，区间宽度至多为pᵢ/2。

captions.text: The midpoint lies inside its source interval.
captions.translation: 中点位于对应信源区间内部。

captions.text: Each cell endpoint is at most one cell width from the midpoint.
captions.translation: 区间端点到中点的距离至多为一个区间宽度。

captions.text: The endpoint distance is at most half the interval width. Which containment does that guarantee?
captions.translation: 端点距离不超过区间宽度的一半。这能保证哪种包含关系？

captions.text: Therefore the entire dyadic cell lies inside its source interval.
captions.translation: 因此整个二进制区间都包含在信源区间内。

captions.text: Distinct source intervals are disjoint.
captions.translation: 不同信源区间互不相交。

captions.text: Their contained dyadic cells are also disjoint.
captions.translation: 其中的二进制区间也彼此不交。

captions.text: A dyadic cell for a word contains every cell for its extensions.
captions.translation: 某个词的二进制区间包含其所有扩展词的区间。

captions.text: Disjoint cells therefore imply that no codeword prefixes another.
captions.translation: 区间互不相交，因此没有码字是另一者的前缀。

captions.text: The SFE construction is prefix-free.
captions.translation: SFE构造得到前缀码。

captions.text: Its length is at least negative log two p i plus one.
captions.translation: 其码长至少为−log₂pᵢ+1。

captions.text: It is strictly less than negative log two p i plus two.
captions.translation: 其码长严格小于−log₂pᵢ+2。

captions.text: Averaging gives a length below H plus two bits.
captions.translation: 取平均得到码长小于H+2比特。

captions.text: The general prefix-code lower bound still gives H at most L.
captions.translation: 一般前缀码下界仍给出H≤L。

captions.text: Thus SFE satisfies H at most L and L strictly below H plus two.
captions.translation: 所以SFE满足H≤L<H+2。

captions.text: The extra protection bit ensures the selected cell fits inside the source interval.
captions.translation: 额外的保护位确保选中区间落在信源区间内部。

captions.text: For a dyadic midpoint, choose the terminating binary expansion followed by zeros.
captions.translation: 若中点是有限二进制小数，选择有限展开并在末尾补零。

captions.text: Use half-open intervals consistently at shared boundaries.
captions.translation: 对共享边界始终采用半开区间约定。

captions.text: No source symbol with zero probability needs a midpoint.
captions.translation: 概率为零的信源符号无需定义中点。

captions.text: The construction assumes a known distribution and a fixed symbol order.
captions.translation: 该构造假设分布已知且符号顺序固定。

captions.text: The cumulative interval uses the source probabilities, not estimated code lengths.
captions.translation: 累积区间使用信源概率，而非估计的码长。

captions.text: Changing the fixed symbol order changes intervals but preserves the proof.
captions.translation: 改变固定符号顺序会改变区间，但不影响证明。

captions.text: This gives a constructive code whenever the distribution is available.
captions.translation: 只要分布已知，这就给出可构造的编码。

captions.text: For probabilities one half, one quarter, one quarter, the cumulative midpoints are one quarter, five eighths, and seven eighths.
Their binary expansions begin point zero one, point one zero one, and point one one one.
captions.translation: 它们的二进制展开分别以0.01、0.101、0.111开头。

captions.text: The selected lengths are two, three, and three.
captions.translation: 所选码长为2、3、3。

captions.text: The SFE codewords are zero one, one zero one, and one one one.
Their dyadic cells lie inside the three original probability intervals.
captions.translation: 它们的二进制区间分别位于三个原概率区间内。

captions.text: Average length is two point five bits, while entropy is one point five.
captions.translation: 平均码长为2.5比特，熵为1.5比特。

captions.text: Next, ask what coding means when the distribution is unknown.
captions.translation: 接下来讨论分布未知时编码意味着什么。

captions.text: Two sources swap which symbol is common. Choose one code before discovering the source.
captions.translation: 两个信源中，最常见的符号互换了。必须在得知信源之前选择同一码。

captions.text: Source one gives probabilities .8, .1, .1. Source two gives .1, .8, .1.
Code one gives A one bit and B and C two bits. Code two gives B the one-bit word instead.
captions.translation: 码一给A一比特，给B和C各两比特。码二改为给B一比特。

captions.text: Which of these two codebooks costs less for both sources?
captions.translation: 这两本码表中，哪一本对两个信源都更便宜？

captions.text: Neither. The costs are 1.2 versus 1.9 bits, and they exchange when the source switches.
captions.translation: 都不是。代价分别是1.2和1.9比特；切换信源后，二者互换。

captions.text: A universal encoder is selected without knowing the true source distribution.
captions.translation: 通用编码器在不知道真实信源分布时选定。

captions.text: The word universal is incomplete unless we name a source class.
captions.translation: 若不说明信源类别，“通用”一词并不完整。

captions.text: It also needs a performance criterion.
captions.translation: 还需要明确性能标准。

captions.text: For a fixed distribution P and block length n, measure expected code length under P.
captions.translation: 对固定分布P和块长n，计算P下的期望码长。

captions.text: Subtract n times H of P to obtain expected redundancy.
captions.translation: 减去nH(P)，得到期望冗余。

captions.text: This is pointwise redundancy for that particular P.
captions.translation: 这就是该特定P下的逐源冗余。

captions.text: A sequence of codes can be studied separately for each fixed P.
captions.translation: 可对每个固定P分别研究一列码。

captions.text: Another benchmark takes the worst expected redundancy over a class C.
captions.translation: 另一种基准是在类别C上取最坏期望冗余。

captions.text: For each block length, minimize that worst value over admissible codes.
captions.translation: 对每个块长，在允许的码中最小化该最坏值。

captions.text: This is a minimax expected-redundancy criterion.
captions.translation: 这就是极小极大期望冗余准则。

captions.text: Pointwise and minimax questions are different.
captions.translation: 逐源问题与极小极大问题不同。

captions.text: A code can perform well for one distribution and poorly for another.
captions.translation: 一个码可能对某分布表现良好，却对另一个分布很差。

captions.text: The class might be all IID laws on a finite alphabet.
captions.translation: 信源类别可以是有限字母表上的所有IID分布。

captions.text: It might instead restrict parameters or impose memory structure.
captions.translation: 也可以限制参数范围或规定记忆结构。

captions.text: A redundancy statement must say which choice is intended.
captions.translation: 冗余结论必须说明采用哪种设定。

captions.text: An unknown model can cause a mismatch penalty like KL divergence.
captions.translation: 模型未知会引入类似KL散度的错配代价。

captions.text: A universal method aims to control coding cost without selecting P in advance.
captions.translation: 通用方法力图在事先不选定P时控制编码代价。

captions.text: This aim does not imply zero overhead at every finite block length.
captions.translation: 这一目标不意味着每个有限块长下开销都为零。

captions.text: It also does not imply optimality for every individual sequence.
captions.translation: 它也不意味着对每个单独序列都最优。

captions.text: Expected redundancy is averaged over the source law.
captions.translation: 期望冗余是按照信源分布平均的。

captions.text: A worst-case sequence criterion would require a different definition.
captions.translation: 最坏序列准则需要另行定义。

captions.text: A specific theorem must identify its code, class, and asymptotic claim.
captions.translation: 具体定理必须指出编码器、信源类和渐近结论。

captions.text: We make no general rate claim from the word universal alone.
captions.translation: 仅凭“通用”一词，我们不作一般速率断言。

captions.text: LZ78 provides a concrete dictionary mechanism that does not start from P.
captions.translation: LZ78提供一种无需预先给定P的具体词典机制。

captions.text: One short example illustrates its operation, not its asymptotic performance.
captions.translation: 一个短例子只说明其操作，不证明渐近性能。

captions.text: A pointwise question fixes P before taking block length large.
captions.translation: 逐源问题先固定P，再令块长增大。

captions.text: A minimax question takes the worst P in the class at each length.
captions.translation: 极小极大问题则在每个块长下取类别内最坏的P。

captions.text: The order of optimization and limits matters.
captions.translation: 优化与取极限的顺序很重要。

captions.text: No pointwise or minimax theorem is proved in this discussion.
captions.translation: 本段讨论并未证明逐源或极小极大定理。

captions.text: Next, encode and decode that example explicitly.
captions.translation: 接下来明确演示该例的编码与解码。

captions.text: Use the binary input string zero one zero zero one zero zero.
captions.translation: 使用二进制输入串0100100。

captions.text: The dictionary begins with the empty phrase at index zero.
captions.translation: 词典以索引0的空短语开始。

captions.text: At each step, find the longest dictionary phrase matching the unread prefix.
captions.translation: 每一步寻找与未读前缀匹配的最长词典短语。

captions.text: Append the next input symbol to form a new phrase.
captions.translation: 再接上下一个输入符号，形成新短语。

captions.text: Output the old phrase index and the new symbol.
captions.translation: 输出旧短语索引及新符号。

captions.text: Then add the new phrase at the next dictionary index.
captions.translation: 随后将新短语加入下一个词典索引。

captions.text: Initially, zero is not yet in the dictionary.
captions.translation: 起初，短语0尚未进入词典。

captions.text: Emit index zero with new symbol zero, then add phrase zero at index one.
captions.translation: 输出(0,0)，再将短语0加入索引1。

captions.text: The unread input now begins with one.
captions.translation: 此时未读输入以1开头。

captions.text: Emit index zero with symbol one, then add phrase one at index two.
captions.translation: 输出(0,1)，再将短语1加入索引2。

captions.text: The remaining input begins with zero zero.
captions.translation: 剩余输入以00开头。

captions.text: Phrase zero already exists. Which record sends the next new phrase?
captions.translation: 短语0已在词典里。下一条新短语应发送哪条记录？

captions.text: Emit index one with zero, adding phrase zero zero at index three.
captions.translation: 输出(1,0)，并将短语00加入索引3。

captions.text: The remaining input begins with one zero.
captions.translation: 剩余输入以10开头。

captions.text: Phrase one exists, so append zero.
captions.translation: 短语1已存在，因此接上0。

captions.text: Emit index two with zero, adding phrase one zero at index four.
captions.translation: 输出(2,0)，并将短语10加入索引4。

captions.text: One final zero remains, and phrase zero already exists. Should the dictionary gain another entry?
captions.translation: 最后还剩一个0，而短语0已存在。词典还应该新增一项吗？

captions.text: At known end of file, emit a pointer-only terminal record for index one.
captions.translation: 已知文件结束时，输出指向索引1的仅指针终止记录。

captions.text: The decoder treats that distinguished terminal record as the final existing phrase.
captions.translation: 译码器将该特殊终止记录视为最后一个已有短语。

captions.text: It does not add a new dictionary phrase for that terminal record.
captions.translation: 译码器不会为该终止记录新增词典短语。

captions.text: Now decode the first pair as empty phrase plus zero.
captions.translation: 现在将第一对译为“空短语加0”。

captions.text: Output zero and add dictionary entry one as zero.
captions.translation: 输出0，并将词典项1加入为0。

captions.text: Decode the second pair as empty phrase plus one.
captions.translation: 将第二对译为“空短语加1”。

captions.text: Output one and add dictionary entry two as one.
captions.translation: 输出1，并将词典项2加入为1。

captions.text: The third pair points to entry one and appends zero.
captions.translation: 第三对指向词典项1并接上0。

captions.text: Output zero zero and add that phrase at entry three.
captions.translation: 输出00，并将该短语加入词典项3。

captions.text: The fourth pair points to entry two and appends zero.
captions.translation: 第四对指向词典项2并接上0。

captions.text: Output one zero and add that phrase at entry four.
captions.translation: 输出10，并将该短语加入词典项4。

captions.text: The terminal pointer outputs entry one, which is zero.
captions.translation: 终止指针输出词典项1，即0。

captions.text: Concatenate outputs zero, one, zero zero, one zero, and zero.
The seven recovered bits, in order, are zero, one, zero, zero, one, zero, zero.
captions.translation: 按顺序恢复的七个比特是0、1、0、0、1、0、0。

captions.text: Both sides added phrases zero, one, zero zero, and one zero in order.
captions.translation: 两端依次加入短语0、1、00和10。

captions.text: For raw fields, include a pointer and one new bit in each ordinary record.
captions.translation: 按原始字段计，每个普通记录含指针和一个新比特。

captions.text: Before the four records, dictionary sizes are one, two, three, and four.
captions.translation: 四条普通记录之前，词典大小依次为1、2、3、4。

captions.text: Pointer widths are zero, one, two, and two bits using ceiling log two size.
captions.translation: 按⌈log₂词典大小⌉，指针宽度依次为0、1、2、2比特。

captions.text: The pointers therefore use five bits, and new symbols use four bits.
captions.translation: 因此普通指针共用5比特，新符号共用4比特。

captions.text: The terminal pointer uses three bits with dictionary size five. Does this seven-bit example actually save bits?
captions.translation: 词典大小为五时，末尾指针占三比特。这段七比特输入真的被压缩了吗？

captions.text: This gives twelve counted field bits under the stated convention.
captions.translation: 按上述约定，计数字段共12比特。

captions.text: Framing, record types, and end-of-file signaling add separate protocol overhead.
captions.translation: 帧界定、记录类型和文件结束信号另有协议开销。

captions.text: This small dictionary example proves no asymptotic compression theorem.
captions.translation: 这个小词典例子不证明任何渐近压缩定理。

captions.text: It only shows synchronized parsing and dictionary growth.
captions.translation: 它只展示同步解析与词典增长。

captions.text: Next, noisy channels require a different notion of reliable coding.
captions.translation: 下一集转向噪声信道下的可靠编码问题。
